failures.observed: Default Linux resolution selected torch 2.14.0 and CUDA 13 packages for a CPU-only benchmark.
failures.disposition: Stopped before installation; installed torch==2.8.0+cpu and torchvision==0.23.0+cpu from the official PyTorch CPU index, then installed Docling.
failures.impact: Docling needs an explicit CPU pin to avoid unnecessary GPU dependencies in this environment.

failures.observed: The first conversion failed before source processing because HTTPX detected the task SOCKS proxy but socksio was absent.
failures.disposition: Pinned socksio==1.0.0 locally and retried; retained measured results were generated offline after models were cached.
failures.impact: Proxy environments require an undeclared transport extra for first-time model download.
